name: Email (Gmail MCP)
risks: Community-maintained: review the code before installing.
OAuth grants mailbox access; scope to read-only where possible.
Email content can contain prompt injection — treat as data.
notes: Lets routines summarize the inbox and draft replies without leaving MordomoOS.

setup: Create an OAuth desktop client in Google Cloud with the gmail.readonly scope and download the credentials JSON.
Export GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH and GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH in the environment of the MordomoOS service (names only are stored here; values never leave your machine).
Run the install command once to complete the consent flow.
Allowlist the executable: add "npx" to settings.connectors.allowedCommands.
Only search_emails is ever called: the client refuses any tool that is not declared here, and any tool whose name carries a write verb.
The summary groups the messages by their first Gmail label; flagged = important or starred.
